desktop.notesZh:
批次十五（splash 后台启动 + 工作流路径统一预览手势 + 测试流 00 前置节点与门禁 + 会话图仅验证挂测试流）
① splash：停留超过 5 秒浮出「BAF服务首次启动时间稍久，请耐心等待」与「后台启动」按钮；点击后隐藏 splash、启动转入后台（托盘提示「正在后台启动…」），启动完成后主窗口照常出现。② 工作流页所有路径/文件名 hover 显示下划线：文件（配置文件、状态脚本、测试流资产/报告/配置文件 chips）点击进入模态预览，预览右上角两键「打开」「打开文件夹」；目录（项目路径、受保护路径、测试流目录值 chips）点击直接打开文件夹；企业规范只读文档仅支持预览，不再提供打开手势。③ 测试流卡片：删除八步链说明；「前置」改为与 01 gcc 编译同款样式的「00」节点置于首位；启用/失败中止开关改为单行药丸组样式，更和谐不突兀。④ 指令集：删除「状态指令 · 按阶段查看」标题与说明。⑤ 工作流各 Tab 首元素与 Tab 标签间距统一。⑥ 会话工作流图：测试流跳转仅保留在「验证」节点；验证阶段新增 test-flow 必需检查——测试流（按开关）需全部完成成功（覆盖率与静态分析报告全绿）验证才算通过，不过则按既有 T11 逻辑退回实现阶段并派发修复工单（模型回实现修复、重跑测试流、再验证，从不在验证内迭代）；基线测试命令为 <enterprise-tbd> 占位的工作区不启用该门禁（与质量门禁占位语义一致，避免新工作区死锁）。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch fifteen (splash background start + unified path-preview gestures on the Workflow page + test-flow 00 prerequisite node and gate + session flow links the test-flow only at verify)
(1) Splash: after 5s a hint appears — BAF services take a while on first start — with a Start-in-background button; clicking hides the splash while boot continues (tray tooltip shows starting-in-background) and the main window appears when ready. (2) Every path/filename on the Workflow page underlines on hover: files (config file, state hooks, test-flow asset/report/config chips) open a preview modal whose top-right carries Open and Reveal-in-folder; directories (project path, protected paths, test-flow dir values) reveal the folder directly; the read-only enterprise standards keep preview as their only gesture. (3) Test-flow card: the eight-step intro retires; the prerequisite becomes a 00 node styled like the 01 gcc node, first on the rail; the enable/halt switches restyle as one quiet pill row. (4) Commands tab drops the state-commands title and intro. (5) Uniform first-element-to-tab-label spacing across the Workflow tabs. (6) Session workflow chart: the test-flow jump chip remains only on the verify node; verify now runs a required test-flow check — every enabled step's durable evidence (coverage + static-analysis reports) must be green or verify fails back to implement through the existing T11 path with a fix work order (the model fixes in implement, reruns the test flow, then verifies again — it never iterates inside verify); baselines whose test command is an <enterprise-tbd> placeholder stay ungated, matching the quality-gate placeholder semantics to avoid fresh-workspace deadlocks.
